scope: R3 P256 behavior at the configured precompile address and actual-before-static stale skip policy complete. Other R3 probes and overall task 9 remain open.

contract.verification: Corpus valid signature independently checked with standard ECDSA and P256 public-key validation. A zero-r invalid signature is also verified to fail. Each node executes both read-only eth_call requests with gas 0x186a0 within a five-second node budget.
contract.classification: Valid input returns the one word and invalid input returns empty: supported. Both empty: unsupported/SKIP. Constant acceptance, malformed response, missing RPC API and HTTP failure: unknown/BLOCKED. Unknown outranks unsupported.
contract.skipPolicy: A static provided tag cannot invalidate skipsOn before runtime probing. Actual unsupported preserves expected SKIP; actual support makes a stale skipsOn FAIL before hooks/body. Without a runtime gate, static behavior is retained. capability-gate.json records runtimeConfirmationPending for this candidate.

limitations: The probe qualifies valid/invalid P256 verification behavior at address 0x100, not every precompile edge case or exact gas cost.
Malformed/constant responses and transport boundaries use authenticated unit fixtures; native gateways never fabricate replies.
Browser source did not change and browser was not separately rerun.
R3 transaction/account/fork/other RPC probes, P4 adequacy, R4/R5 remainders, R6/full Linux HEAD L1, tasks 10–14 and frozen Web14 acceptance remain pending.
